issue.title: Next.js 13 example with the `app` router

repository.name: material-ui
repository.description: Material UI: Comprehensive React component library that implements Google's Material Design. Free forever.

issue.body:
### Duplicates

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Latest version

- [X] I have tested the latest version

### Summary 💡

There is a great example of how to use MUI with next.js (https://github.com/mui/material-ui/blob/master/examples/nextjs-with-typescript) in this repository. 

Yet, a new version of Next.js was released recently: https://nextjs.org/blog/next-13

This introduces several new concepts and ways to write React apps with server-side components in mind. To migrate from the old Next.js to the new version, one needs to do several things:
* Start using the `app/` directory instead of `pages/` (although this can be done incrementally)
* Inside the components of the `app/` directory, one has to use `fetch` (or any other `async`/`await`-based data fetching method instead of `getInitialProps`, `getServerSideProps`, or `getStaticProps`.
* The `_document.tsx` and `_app.tsx` should be refactored into a global `layout.tsx`: https://beta.nextjs.org/docs/upgrade-guide#migrating-_documentjs-and-_appjs

It would be great to get directions on how to use MUI with emotion styles and cache in this scenario.
Would be even better to have a sample app like [the one above](https://github.com/mui/material-ui/blob/master/examples/nextjs-with-typescript).

### Examples 🌈

_No response_

### Motivation 🔦

Next.js 13 is a major new version that introduces several exciting features that would be really great to use in our apps.
It would be great to have a guide or directions on how to integrate MUI with the new version of Next.js instead of the old `_document` and `_app` based one.

I think there will be many developers that would want to update to the newer version and might get stuck (like myself) on the MUI integration and how the emotion styles and cache work on this new "server-first" environment without `getInitialProps`.

issue.body:
Next.js 13 was released with built-in layout support in `/app` folder-based project. However, Emotion and MUI are not compatible yet with it. This issue tracks the related issues for implementing above-mentioned feature: ~~https://github.com/nextauthjs/next-auth/issues/5639~~ next-auth is now compatible with Node.js 18 ~~https://github.com/nextauthjs/next-auth/issues/5650~~ next-auth is now compatible with Next.js 13 We can now upgrade to Next.js 13, but we cannot use `/app` folders yet until these issues are solved: https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/41994 https://github.com/emotion-js/emotion/issues/2928 https://github.com/mui/material-ui/issues/34896 https://github.com/mui/material-ui/issues/34898 https://github.com/mui/material-ui/issues/34905 ~~https://github.com/nextauthjs/next-auth/issues/5647~~ ---- Related: https://beta.nextjs.org/docs/rendering/server-and-client-components#convention ```ts 'use client'; import { useState } from 'react'; export default function Counter() { const [count, setCount] = useState(0); return (

issue.title: Upgrade to Next.js@13.0.2
issue.body:
## 🤔 해결하려는 문제가 무엇인가요? - Next.js 13.0.0 마이그레이션 ## 🎉 어떻게 해결했나요? - `next`, `eslint-config-next`의 버전을 `13.0.0`으로 올렸어요
### `appDir` 비활성화 현재 `appDir`을 활성화하면 (8c780631e6289c1d616851769484835ed8823849) `emotion`과 충돌이 일어나는 것 같습니다. ![스크린샷 2022-10-27 오전 12 03 07](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26461307/198066902-fd7311b9-e2e7-4df4-ba57-3b8dce5ca4d7.png) 단적으로 `next.config.js`의 `emotion` 옵션을 비활성화하면 정상적으로 실행되는 것을 확인했어요. 아직 이르다고 생각되어 비활성화 해두었습니다.
### `tsconfig` ![스크린샷 2022-10-27 오전 12 22 45](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26461307/198067585-6aedad4f-03d2-40d9-aec3-dfffaa11a7bb.png) 실행 시 tsconfig를 업데이트 해주더라구요. fc6bcae800d8e3bcc757d12b7b1f238aee817270 ``` Strict-mode is set to false by default ``` 라고는 하는데, strict 옵션이 false가 되진 않네요..?
### `dev:turbo` 스크립트 설정 ``` yarn dev:turbo ``` 위 명령어를 이용해 dev 서버를 킬 수 있도록 설정해 두었어요. > `turbopack`이 아직 빌드는 지원하지 않는다고 해요. 근데 무슨 용건에선지 (아직도 모름) 웹에 접속 시 다음 에러를 뱉더라구요. ``` error - [resolve] [next]/dev/client.ts Error resolving commonjs request unable to resolve module "typescript" Error resolving type request unable to resolve module "node" [next]/dev/hmr-client.ts Error resolving commonjs request unable to resolve module "typescript" Error resolving type request unable to resolve module "node" ... ``` 일단은 그냥 데브 모드로 개발을 해야할 것 같아요 ,, ### 📚 Attachment (Option) `turbopack`이 궁금해 조금 읽어봤는데 눈에 띄는 사항을 공유 드려요 - `next/dynamic`이 아직 지원되지 않는다고 합니다 https://turbo.build/pack/docs/features/frameworks#nextdynamic - 환경 변수도 라이브 리로딩이 된다고 합니다 https://turbo.build/pack/docs/features/environment-variables#live-reloading - 발표에서 인상깊게 봤던 리모트 캐싱은 아직 안된다고 합니다 https://turbo.build/pack/docs/features/environment-variables#live-reloading closes #6
